name: global-unbreakable-viewer-web
description: Static globe frontend for the Global Resilience Explorer. `npm run build` transpiles + minifies src/app.jsx into app.js (loaded by index.html as a plain script).

scripts.build: esbuild src/app.jsx --jsx=transform --jsx-factory=React.createElement --jsx-fragment=React.Fragment --minify --target=es2018 --banner:js="/* Generated from src/app.jsx by npm run build — edit the .jsx source, not this file. */" --outfile=app.js
